messages:
From: Ethan Cole <ethan.cole@scoutbridge.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Final SOW + proposed cutover windows

Rachel —

Thanks again for walking us through the platform yesterday. Attached is the SOW with the two minor edits our legal team requested (see page 3). We also want to lock in a tentative cutover window in July — ideally a weeknight to minimize traffic. Our engineering lead, Maya, suggested Jul 20–22 (US-PDT) or Jul 27–29 as fallbacks.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can support a phased cutover (pilot org of 50 users the first night, full ramp the following night) and who from your side will be the primary contact for runbook sign-off?

Attachments: SOW_v2.pdf (PDF, 487 KB)

Appreciate it —
Ethan Cole
Head of Ops, ScoutBridge
ethan.cole@scoutbridge.com
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>

Cc: Maya Lin <maya.lin@scoutbridge.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Final SOW + proposed cutover windows

Team —

Looping you in to start the sales→CS handoff for ScoutBridge (Deal DEAL-8342-SB). Key context:
- Contract: SOW_v2.pdf attached by customer; legal redlines expected (they flagged data retention clause on p3).
- Cutover ask: phased night-window rollout; customer prefers Jul 20–22 or Jul 27–29.
- Pilot scope: 50 seed users first night, then full org (~1,200 users) day two.
- Tech: ScoutBridge will run identity via SAML; our infra team must provision the VPC peering and set up the private endpoint.

Asks:
1) Karthik — own runbook & MOP sign-off and confirm whether we can support phased cutover across two nights.
2) Monica — lead the customer success onboarding (post-cutover adoption plan + 30/60/90 milestones).
3) Tessa — coordinate CS training sessions and the kickoff cadence; draft invite for the pilot kickoff.

I attached a first-pass MOP matrix (MOP-deployment-matrix.xlsx) with tentative responsibilities. Please reply with availability for a 30-min pre-cutover sync this week.

Attachments: MOP-deployment-matrix.xlsx (Excel, 52 KB)

—
Rachel Kim

Thanks Rachel — I can take runbook ownership. Quick notes after looking through the MOP:
- Phased cutover: yes, we support a two-night approach. Pilot night will run in canary mode (route 10% traffic to new infra, smoke tests + throughput check). Full ramp night requires final KV cache warm-up and quota bump scheduled.
- Need from ScoutBridge: a list of the 50 pilot users (emails) 5 business days before pilot and confirmation on SAML metadata.
- Internal blockers: VPC peering request must be raised by 7/6 to hit 7/20 window. I'll open an infra ticket and tag Monica for any dependency escalations.

I've added a redlines doc with legal notes (redlines_ScoutBridge.docx) and a short checklist inline to the MOP. Propose a pre-cutover sync: Thu 7/2 10:30am PT. If that doesn't work, Thu 7/2 4:00pm PT also OK.
